description: Multi-phase plans currently in flight. Each phase references roadmap item ids; the activePhase section breaks the current phase into concrete tasks with status. Survives conversation compactions — a fresh session can pick up by reading this file.

phases.title: Reflection over session logs: digests, delphi, user/self models

activePhase.title: Reflection over session logs: digests, delphi, user/self models
activePhase.goal: Build edict 0010 to its acceptance criteria: digests that survive cleanup, due logic, delphi with checked citations, Momus-reviewed proposals applied only by the user, user and self models with history and aspirations, Windows CI.
activePhase.sequencing: Fixtures first (real transcripts, scrubbed), then digests and due (the benchmark's baseline), then check/pending/models, then delphi, skills and CLI. Local runner waits on T-e5.

tasks.title: Real fixtures: scrubbed transcripts with rejection, interrupts, classifier denials, failures, subagent
tasks.resolution: Fixtures from real transcripts, scrubbed by tests/fixtures/reflection/scrub.py (salted hashes): Kohl's capture session (rejection, mid-reply interrupt, two pre-reply interrupts) and a window of 5e51440f (8 failures, 2 classifier denials, 5 prompt approvals, a Momus subagent), plus two synthetic events. Gap: interrupting a running tool call could not be captured (foreground sleep blocked, long commands backgrounded); its counter is left out and the digest records the gap.

tasks.title: Digests, due, tick, doctor cleanup warning
tasks.resolution: digest.py, due.py, tick.py, doctor check_undigested_sessions. Backfilled this repo's 4 sessions.

tasks.title: check, pending queue, gameplan handover
tasks.resolution: check.py, pending.py; gameplan pending gained a new-task kind. Momus D1-D5 fixed: seed provenance, file/permission target allowlist, render after verdicts, atomic apply with a resolved ledger, stance revise not batchable.

tasks.title: User and self models: history, decay, hand edits, forget, scope, stances, aspirations, dissents
tasks.resolution: models.py: history, decay on read, hash-detected hand edits, hashed tombstones, forget purge/retain, scope, stances with quoted identity clauses, aspirations, self-entry dissents.

tasks.title: delphi agent, /reflect skill, inhale/exhale steps, A/B arm, runners and employer guardrail
tasks.resolution: delphi agent, /reflect skill, inhale/exhale steps, arms.py, runners.py (employer guardrail; headless bounded tools, 2 attempts). Dry run on real digests passed check on the second try; its notes shaped details, approved_at_prompt and delphi's instructions.

tasks.title: Windows CI job, docs, Momus review, PR
tasks.resolution: PR #39 (commits c4a2ec8, c524e37, 5845e75). CI green on Linux (3.10, 3.12 x3 TZ) and windows-latest (94 passed; the drive-letter test ran there). Momus: all 13 implementation defects fixed with tests.

tasks.title: local runner (needs T-e5)
tasks.details: Blocked on T-e5 local model backends. Until then local behaves as inhale.

tasks.title: Verify CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR redirects transcripts
tasks.details: Edict: confirm before building and record the version. Momus found only third-party sources.
tasks.resolution: Read from Claude Code 2.1.300's bundle (not run, to avoid copying credentials): the projects dir is (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR ?? join(homedir(), '.claude')) + 'projects', and transcripts are written there as <session>.jsonl. paths.claude_dir() matches.

tasks.title: Experiment log (0010 amendment 3) and docs/experiments/reflection.md
tasks.resolution: explog.py: runs (reflect done), resolutions (pending apply/drop), arms, monthly model changes; allowlisted fields, safe strings only; reflect log / log export. Narrative in docs/experiments/reflection.md with the baseline, fixture capture, dry run 1 and Momus's review.
